verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an official JavaScript SDK for collecting web events, and the docs say instrumenting one of its SDKs sends standardized data to many destinations. An HTTP API supports sending events from servers, and an event-spec section exists, but the pack never names mobile or server SDKs or the track/identify/page calls. missing for 10: evidence of official mobile SDKs, evidence of official server-side SDKs, documented tracking-spec details covering track/identify/page, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-platform SDK collection

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can collect events from web, mobile, and server apps through official SDKs that implement a documented tracking spec (track, identify, page)

citations.quote: RudderStack's JavaScript SDK lets you track customer event data from your website and send it to your specified destinations.
Instrument one RudderStack SDK and automatically send standardized data to hundreds of destinations
Send event data from source to connected destinations
